fields.description: The sales channel every product in this batch is enriched for. One channel per batch: the field spec, the validation rules and the image step all come from the channel's adapter, so a mixed batch would have no single answer for any of them.
fields.label: Channel

fields.description: Products per background job. The batch is split into chunks of this size and one job is queued per chunk, so this is the knob that trades parallelism (more, smaller chunks) against queue pressure.
fields.label: Batch Size

fields.description: Translates the Chinese text printed on the product's supplier photos into English. Costs money per image, and only works for photos reachable from the public internet.
fields.label: Translate images

fields.description: Puts the product's main image on a plain white background. Costs money per image, and only works for photos reachable from the public internet. A channel with no such requirement ignores it.
fields.label: White background (main image)

fields.description: AI-retouches the product's own photos. Costs money per image, and only works for photos reachable from the public internet. A channel with no such capability ignores it.
fields.label: Regenerate images

fields.description: Skip products that already have an enriched listing on this channel, so re-running a batch only fills the gaps.
fields.label: Skip Already Enriched

fields.description: Passed to every run in this batch — condition, provenance, or anything the product data and photos won't capture.
fields.label: Notes for the agent
